title: The two versions of the file agree, except one record
question: Do the neighbourhood and supervisor-district versions hold the same records?
finding: The neighbourhood and district versions hold the same 311,824 record numbers. 1 record is dated to a different fiscal year in each, which is why the 2015-16 and 2016-17 totals differ by one. 2,513 of 272,196 records placed in a named neighbourhood and district (0.9%) pair a neighbourhood with a district that holds under 2% of that neighbourhood's records. 111,120 records (36%) have no client number. The file was last updated 2020-05-21 and stops at fiscal 2018-19.
how: Both files joined on Record ID; fields compared; neighbourhood x district cross-table.
limits: Neighbourhood and district may have been geocoded at different times or from different addresses; district lines were redrawn in 2022.
